title: Gigi Hadid Cut the Ribbon on Her Fourth Guest in Residence Store with Cashmere, Caviar, and Caricatures
summary: Model and founder Gigi Hadid, clad in a shrunken top and tartan skirt, celebrated the debut of her label’s fourth U.S. store—and its very first uptown address.

title: New Balance’s Luxe Dad Shoe Is a Half-Tweed, Half-Leather Masterpiece
summary: New Balance releases a 991v1 Made in UK "Tweed Luxe Leather" sneaker, and it's exactly how it sounds. It's a luxe dad shoe made with tweed & leather.

title: Gigi Hadid Gets Cozy in “Sweater Weather Cocktail Attire” to Celebrate Opening of Madison Avenue Guest in Residence Location
summary: On Thursday night, Hadid hosted a party to mark the opening of Guest in Residence’s Madison Avenue location, appearing in a cashmere plaid skirt paired with a halter top and cowboy boots.
